item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We demand a ban on its development. Preventing that catastrophe must come before winning an AI race.

2. We cannot accept a billion deaths as the price of technological ambition. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe on at least that scale. We must stop it from being built.

3. We stand for a future in which humanity survives and flourishes. Superintelligent AI built within the next 20 years will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We need a ban—not a race toward disaster.

### (b) Newsletter opening

If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We refuse to treat those lives as an acceptable price for technological progress. We are working for a ban on superintelligence because preventing that catastrophe is more important than any company’s ambitions or any government’s desire to win an AI race. We must draw a clear line between tools that serve humanity and superintelligent systems that threaten our survival. Our task is to turn that line into enforceable policy. We will keep making the case, building public support, and pressing policymakers to act before that line is crossed.
